verdict.rationale: Pulumi's own docs show stacks as a core concept alongside config and secrets ('projects, stacks, config, secrets'), offer 'unlimited projects, stacks, and environments,' and describe a unified workflow for configuration. A community user reports managing 5+ environments with Pulumi. However, no cited evidence explicitly documents using separate stacks to hold per-environment (dev/staging/prod) configuration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-stack config values mapped to dev/staging/prod, details of the stack config mechanism, and hands-on corroboration of a multi-environment stack workflow.
